LightningComponentBundle.description: Displays the valid values of a dependent picklist for a specified controlling value. IMPORTANT: The controlling and dependent fields must already have a Field Dependency relationship configured in Object Manager.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: API name of the object containing both fields. Example: Nomination__c

property.name: controllingFieldApiName
property.label: Controlling Field API Name
property.description: API name of the controlling field in an existing Salesforce Field Dependency. The field itself will not be shown to the user.

property.name: controllingValue
property.label: Controlling Value
property.description: The predetermined API value of the controlling field. Example: Online. The user will not be asked to select this value.

property.name: dependentFieldApiName
property.label: Dependent Field API Name
property.description: API name of the dependent picklist. This field must already be configured as dependent on the Controlling Field in Object Manager.

property.name: recordTypeId
property.label: Record Type Id
property.description: Optional. Leave blank to use the object's default record type. Supply a Record Type Id if the available picklist values should be based on a specific record type.

property.name: label
property.label: Field Label
property.description: Label displayed above the dependent picklist.

property.name: placeholder
property.label: Placeholder
property.description: Text displayed before the user selects a value.

property.name: required
property.label: Required
property.description: Require the user to select a dependent picklist value before continuing.

property.name: messageWhenValueMissing
property.label: Required Field Message
property.description: Validation message displayed when Required is selected and the user has not chosen a value.

property.name: selectedValue
property.label: Selected Value
property.description: The selected dependent picklist API value.
